# Purpose

A standard conceptual benchmark for the WBM + IHACRES model (notebook 03),
to tell whether its limits are specific to that model or shared by lumped
conceptual models in general.

**Model.** GR4J (Perrin et al. 2003, *J. Hydrol.* 279:275), with 4
parameters: production store X1, groundwater exchange X2 (negative = loss),
routing store X3, and unit-hydrograph time base X4. It is coupled to the
CemaNeige snow model (Valéry et al. 2014, *J. Hydrol.* 517:1166): 2
parameters (C1 snowpack thermal-state weighting, C2 degree-day melt
factor), run on `r params$n_layers` elevation bands built from the basin
hypsometry. Temperature and precipitation are extrapolated from the
basin-mean elevation to each band. The implementation is `airGR`
(Coron et al. 2017).

**Held equal to notebook 03, so differences reflect model structure:**

- the same GridMET basin-mean forcing
- the same PET: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ETo × the seasonal land-cover Kc
  (`pet_ref_kc()`), without the WBM's zero-ET-under-snow rule (CemaNeige
  handles snow, but GR4J's evaporation doesn't see the snowpack)
- the same 5 blocked water-year folds (no buffer; WY1981 warm-up)
- the same DDS calibration on KGE, 1,000 runs per fold
- 6 free parameters, against the WBM's 8

```{r paths}
out_dir <- params$out_dir %||% here::here("data", "processed", "results", "gr4j_cemaneige")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
res_dir <- function(x) here::here("data", "processed", "results", x)

gauges <- get_test_gauges()
gauges$has_data <- file.exists(here::here("data", "processed", gauges$site_no, "daily.parquet"))
gauge_levels <- gauges$gauge_label
label_of <- function(site) factor(gauges$gauge_label[match(site, gauges$site_no)], levels = gauge_levels)

inputs <- gauges %>%
  dplyr::filter(has_data) %>%
  dplyr::pull(site_no) %>%
  rlang::set_names() %>%
  purrr::map(function(site) {
    p <- function(f) here::here("data", "processed", site, f)
    daily <- arrow::read_parquet(p("daily.parquet"))
    static <- readr::read_csv(p("static.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
    hypso <- readr::read_csv(p("hypsometry.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)$elev_m
    list(daily = daily, static = static, hypso = hypso, pet = pet_ref_kc(daily, static))
  })
```

```{r hypsometry, fig.height = 3.5}
# Elevation range drives how much CemaNeige's bands differ from the mean
purrr::imap_dfr(inputs, ~ tibble::tibble(site_no = .y, pct = 0:100, elev_m = .x$hypso)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gauge = label_of(site_no)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(pct, elev_m, color = gauge)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Percent of basin area below", y = "Elevation (m)", color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "right", legend.text = element_text(size = 7))
```

# Calibrate and cross-validate

```{r run-cv}
bounds <- gr4j_bounds()
knitr::kable(bounds, caption = "Calibration bounds")

gr4j_settings <- list(k_folds = params$k_folds, n_evals = params$n_evals,
                      n_layers = params$n_layers, bounds = bounds)

run_gauge_gr4j <- function(site) {
  cache <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(site, "_gr4j_cv.rds"))
  x <- inputs[[site]]
  site_settings <- c(gr4j_settings, list(static = as.list(x$static), hypso = x$hypso))
  if (file.exists(cache) && !isTRUE(params$rerun)) {
    cached <- readRDS(cache)
    if (isTRUE(all.equal(cached$settings, site_settings))) return(cached)
    message(site, ": cached result used different settings; recalibrating")
  }
  setup <- gr4j_setup(x$daily, x$pet, x$hypso, z_inputs = x$static$elev_m, n_layers = params$n_layers)
  model_fn <- function(p) gr4j_run(setup, p)
  obs <- x$daily$q_mm
  folds <- make_blocked_folds(x$daily$date, k = params$k_folds, warmup_years = 1)

  t0 <- Sys.time()
  cv <- cross_validate_model(model_fn, bounds, obs, folds, objective = kge,
                             n_evals = params$n_evals, n_cores = params$n_cores, seed = 1)
  res <- c(cv, list(settings = site_settings,
                    minutes = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins"))))
  res$metrics$model <- "CemaNeige-GR4J"
  saveRDS(res, cache)
  res
}

cv_results <- purrr::map(rlang::set_names(names(inputs)), run_gauge_gr4j)
metrics <- purrr::imap_dfr(cv_results, ~ dplyr::mutate(.x$metrics, site_no = .y))
cv_params <- purrr::imap_dfr(cv_results, ~ dplyr::mutate(.x$params, site_no = .y))
sims <- purrr::imap_dfr(cv_results, ~ dplyr::mutate(.x$sims, site_no = .y))
traces <- purrr::imap_dfr(cv_results, ~ dplyr::mutate(.x$traces, site_no = .y))

readr::write_csv(metrics, file.path(out_dir, "cv_metrics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(cv_params, file.path(out_dir, "cv_params.csv"))
arrow::write_parquet(sims, file.path(out_dir, "cv_test_sims.parquet"))

tibble::tibble(gauge = label_of(names(cv_results)),
               minutes = purrr::map_dbl(cv_results, "minutes")) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 1, caption = "Calibration time per gauge")
```

```{r convergence, fig.height = 4}
traces %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gauge = label_of(site_no)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(objective > -1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(eval, objective, group = fold)) +
  geom_line(color = "#1b6ca8", alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ gauge, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y", labeller = label_wrap_gen(30)) +
  labs(x = "Model runs", y = "Best training KGE so far") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9)
```

# Results

## Skill on held-out water years: all models

GR4J, the WBM and the benchmark are scored on the identical test days.

```{r compare}
read_metrics <- function(dir, model_filter = NULL) {
  f <- file.path(res_dir(dir), "cv_metrics.csv")
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
  m <- readr::read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% dplyr::filter(set == "test")
  if (!is.null(model_filter)) m <- dplyr::filter(m, model %in% model_filter)
  m
}
all_test <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dplyr::filter(metrics, set == "test"),
  read_metrics(params$wbm_dir, c("WBM + IHACRES", "DOY climatology"))
) %>% dplyr::mutate(gauge = label_of(site_no))

model_cols <- c("CemaNeige-GR4J" = "#459a74", "WBM + IHACRES" = "#1b6ca8",
                "DOY climatology" = "grey40")

all_test %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(kge, nse, log_nse), names_to = "metric") %>%
  ggplot(aes(value, gauge, color = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = model_cols) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

all_test %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gauge, model) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(dplyr::across(c(kge, nse, log_nse, pbias), median), .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2, caption = "Median across test folds")
```

## Overfitting check and parameter stability

```{r train-test, fig.height = 4}
metrics %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gauge = label_of(site_no)) %>%
  dplyr::select(gauge, fold, set, kge) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = set, values_from = kge) %>%
  ggplot(aes(train, test, color = gauge)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 2) + coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "KGE (train)", y = "KGE (test)", color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r param-stability, fig.height = 5}
cv_params %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gauge = label_of(site_no)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(bounds$param), names_to = "param") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(bounds, by = "param") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scaled = (value - lower) / (upper - lower)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(scaled, gauge)) +
  geom_point(color = "#459a74", alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ param, ncol = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Position within calibration bounds (0 = lower, 1 = upper)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Hydrographs, flow duration, and seasonality

```{r join-sims}
read_sims <- function(dir, name) {
  f <- file.path(res_dir(dir), "cv_test_sims.parquet")
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
  arrow::read_parquet(f) %>% dplyr::select(site_no, date, !!name := sim)
}
both <- sims %>% dplyr::select(site_no, date, obs, gr4j = sim)
for (x in list(list(params$wbm_dir, "wbm"))) {
  s <- read_sims(x[[1]], x[[2]])
  if (!is.null(s)) both <- dplyr::left_join(both, s, by = c("site_no", "date"))
}
both_long <- both %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-c(site_no, date), names_to = "series", values_to = "q_mm") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gauge = label_of(site_no))
series_cols <- c(obs = "black", gr4j = "#459a74", wbm = "#1b6ca8")
```

```{r hydrographs, fig.height = 10}
both_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(site_no) %>%
  dplyr::filter(date >= max(date) - 2 * 365) %>%
  ggplot(aes(date, q_mm, color = series)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ gauge, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = series_cols) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Streamflow (mm/day)", color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r fdc, fig.height = 6}
both_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(q_mm)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gauge, series) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(exceedance = 1 - (rank(q_mm, ties.method = "first") - 0.5) / dplyr::n()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(exceedance, pmax(q_mm, 1e-3), color = series)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ gauge, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = series_cols) +
  labs(x = "Exceedance probability", y = "Streamflow (mm/day, log)", color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r seasonal, fig.height = 6}
both_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(month = as.integer(format(date, "%m"))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gauge, series, month) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(q_mm = mean(q_mm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(month, q_mm, color = series)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ gauge, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 4, 7, 10)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = series_cols) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Mean streamflow (mm/day)", color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "top")
```

# Notes

- If GR4J matches or beats the WBM where the WBM struggles (Crystal and
  Duckabush water budgets, Sycamore), that points to WBM structure (snow
  on a single elevation, soil bucket, routing) rather than forcing.
- If both models miss in the same way at a basin, forcing (e.g.
  GridMET precipitation undercatch) is the more likely cause.
